title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows, improve build-matrix caching & parallelism
author: Diego Morales
description:
Motivation: our monolithic CI workflow has grown slow and brittle (longer queue times and repeated installs across matrix jobs). This PR splits lint/test/release into dedicated workflows, modernizes the build matrix, standardizes cache keys, and introduces controlled parallelism for expensive steps (install/build) to reduce total CI runtime and flakiness.

What changed:
- Split .github/workflows/ci.yml into three focused workflows: lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml. This reduces unnecessary job runs on docs/MD-only changes and makes the run history easier to scan.
- Reworked the build matrix to: node versions [18,20], os [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest], and test profiles (unit, integration) but only run integration on push to main/dedicated branches.
- Introduced a centralized cache-utils script (scripts/ci/cache-utils.sh) used by multiple workflows to compute deterministic cache keys and warm caches. This reduces duplicated key logic and makes cache tuning easier.
- Improved actions/cache usage: switched to layered keys (repo+sha of lockfile + node-modules-hash) and added restore-keys to allow partial hits.
- Added an optional cache-warm job that pre-populates caches for the more expensive matrix combinations when a tagged push or scheduled weekly run occurs.
- Controlled parallelism: npm install and build steps now use GitHub Actions concurrency + matrix-parallelism via strategy.max-parallel to avoid saturating runners and causing ephemeral rate limits.
- Kept release automation (release.yml) but hardened it: idempotent tag checks, explicit concurrency group, retry on transient network errors, and updated release-please/action to latest pinned version.
- Hygiene: bumped commonly used GH Actions (actions/checkout, actions/setup-node, pnpm/action-setup) to latest vetted versions, removed deprecated steps, and simplified environment variables.

Checklist:
- [x] Split workflows implemented and smoke tested on a feature branch.
- [x] Cache keys validated locally and on a scheduled run (cache hit rates > 60% for node_modules on repeated runs).
- [x] Release workflow runbook updated in docs/devops/ci.md.
- [x] Observability: added telemetry to CI (workflow run duration metrics) to track improvements.

Impact: average CI wall time reduced ~28% on PR runs (observed across multiple sample PRs) and queue pressure during peak hours reduced due to matrix parallelism controls. This should make iterating faster for engineers and reduce CI spend.

Notes for reviewers: focus on cache key correctness, release job hardening, and any secret/credential exposure in new scripts. The cache-utils.sh script is intentionally small and well-commented to keep logic auditable.

review_comments: Priya Patel: Left a couple of suggestions around the cache key (use lockfile sha + package-lock version to avoid invalidation from unrelated changes). Also request to add a fallback restore-key for partial hits.
Diego Morales (author): Thanks, good catch — updated cache-utils.sh to include lockfile sha and added restore-keys with repo-level fallback. Verified on a scheduled run.
Ava Thompson: Can we limit the integration test matrix to run only on main and release branches? Integration tests are noisy on forks and costy.
Diego Morales (author): Agreed — updated test.yml strategy to only include integration profile for push events and PRs targeting main/release/*.
Marta Ivanova: Release job looks good but please pin the release-please/action to the latest stable commit instead of a floating tag. Also add a 3x retry with backoff for network calls.
Diego Morales (author): Pinning applied and added retry wrapper to release steps. Added brief note in docs/devops/ci.md about manual retry process if needed.
Priya Patel: Verified cache hit rates on the scheduled run — node_modules cache hit ~64% for ubuntu combos. Approving pending CI green.
CI Bot: All checks passed after re-run. build:ubuntu-latest (unit) - pass; build:macos-latest (unit) - pass; lint - pass; release dry-run - pass.
files_diff_snippets:
.github/workflows/test.yml: strategy:
  matrix:
    node: [18, 20]
    os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
  max-parallel: 4

.github/workflows/release.yml: steps:
  - name: Retry release
    uses: actions/retry@v1
    with: attempts: 3
release_notes: Split CI workflows (lint/test/release) to reduce unnecessary runs and improve clarity.
Improved cache keys and added cache warm job — better cache hit rates for node_modules.
Added controlled parallelism for matrix jobs to reduce runner saturation and CI queue times.
Hardened release workflow (idempotency, retries, pinned action versions).
notes: Follow-up: monitor CI run duration metrics for two weeks; plan a post-mortem if regression seen.
Ops: will coordinate with platform team to tune concurrency during peak hours if runner saturation observed.
Security: no new secrets added; release workflow uses existing KMS-wrapped release token; documented in docs/devops/ci.md.
